title: [performance] Report to live has a value as soon as the live record gives one: the Core lines north star is the Scorecard's value over what the record covers, "(since the deploy record began)" beside its name until the 7 days are covered
prompt:
Spawn, mission 4, objective 132 [performance]: the performance north star, "time from report to live", has a value as soon as the live record gives one, measured over what the record covers, and the card says so beside its name.

What "report" and "live" are (crate scorecard/history.rs, objective 081; measure.rs, objective 095):
- A landing's report is its task's last task.reported record before it landed.
- It is live at the first deploy.finished record with ok true at or after the landing.
- Report to live is the median, by nearest rank, over the window's landings that went live. Only landings at or after the live record's start count; that start is the first deploy.finished of any outcome. There is a value only with at least 3 live landings (MIN_N).

Where things stand.
- On the live fleet (11-13 20:00 local), /api/scorecard's fleet scope over its default 7 days gives report_to_live 2674521 ms (44.6 min), p90 6856551 ms (1 h 54 min), n 76, not_live 0, enough true. covered is false: the record began 11-12 03:10 local.
- The Core lines card holds that value back until the record covers all 7 days (crate serve/core_lines/performance.rs, `performance` and `measured`). The north star reads "measuring since 11-12 03:10" until 11-19 03:10, though the Scorecard has had a sound value since the first day.
- The hold dates from the 106 h figure of 11-12, which counted landings from before the record began as going live at its first deploy. Objective 095 fixed that in the Scorecard itself: those landings are left out. The hold is no longer needed for the value to be right.
- Why 44.6 min and not lead-mac's 94 min by hand on 11-12 (sync/review-spawn-2026-11-13.md §1; queue.md, lead 15:30):
  - the 94 min was the Scorecard's 11-12 day alone, read mid-afternoon over the 14 landings live by then;
  - that day's later landings went live faster. The whole day now reads 36.3 min over 54 landings;
  - 44.6 min is the median over all 76 landings since the record began: 11-11 (7, 68.6 min), 11-12 (54, 36.3 min) and 11-13 so far (15, 62.6 min).
  Same rule, a different window.

Read: crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/performance.rs (`performance`, `measured`, `measured_samples`, `performance_line` and their tests), crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/measure.rs (`report_to_live`), web/src/coreLines.ts (`mark`, `windowWords`).

Required behaviour.
- While the live record does not cover the 7 days (the Scorecard's covered false, or the first deploy record later than now less 7 days):
  - the north star performance.report_to_live is the Scorecard's fleet value, with its state by its range as any figure's;
  - it carries measuring_since_ms (the record's start, as today) and window "since the deploy record began";
  - the Core lines card shows that window beside the name, through coreLines.ts as it shows every window: "Time from report to live (since the deploy record began)", with the value in its words ("44 min 35 s").
- Under 3 live landings the Scorecard has no value. Then the north star has none and says "measuring since <MM-DD HH:MM>", as today.
- Covered, it is the Scorecard's value as today, with window "7d" ("(last 7 days)" on the card) and no measuring_since_ms.
- Without a deploy record: no value, no start and no window, as today.
- The hourly host.core_lines sample carries the value from now on, as it carries any figure with one. The trend keeps 095's rule (measured_samples): it draws report to live only from samples taken once the record covers the 7 days. The samples from before 095 hold the record's start (106 h), and all of them fall before then; the samples since are sound but over fewer than 7 days. measured_samples' doc says both reasons. The trend beside the value stays empty until 11-19 03:10.
- What stays as it is:
  - the Scorecard;
  - every other figure;
  - web/src/coreLines.ts and web/src/components/home/CoreLines.tsx: the window is said through the existing `window` field;
  - the polled reads (the same kept scorecard computation, every 60 s at most).
- crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs's module doc still says the figure has no value until covered. That file is 130's, so the sentence is left to the next objective that edits it.

Unit tests (spawn-cli, serve/core_lines/performance.rs):
- the record 2 days old: the value, measuring since its start, window "since the deploy record began", sampled hourly;
- just short of 7 days: the same;
- no record: no value, no start;
- covered (7 days and 30): the value, window "7d", no start;
- from the Scorecard's answer: not covered gives the value with its start and window; under 3 live landings it is not collected, measuring since, no window; covered gives the value with no start.
The test report_to_live_waits_until_the_live_record_covers_the_window becomes report_to_live_is_over_what_the_live_record_covers: its rule, the hold, is what 132 drops. The old name, serve::core_lines::performance::tests::report_to_live_waits_until_the_live_record_covers_the_window, is retired in rsi/scenarios/retired-tests.
Each rule removed alone must fail a test or the scenario.

Files (expected; no other open objective touches them): crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/performance.rs, rsi/scenarios/retired-tests (one line, the retired test above), and rsi/scenarios/095.sh (a kept-scenario edit, 095-kept-edit.diff: its check (2) expected no value while not covered; it now expects the Scorecard's value with measuring_since_ms, and still checks the "measuring since" words for a figure with no value). One crate. The throwaway is +92 −43 (performance.rs +77 −32, 095.sh +14 −11, retired-tests +1), within the size guide. Unchanged, 095.sh fails on the candidate with 2 checks: "(2) the north star while the 7 days are not covered: no value, measuring since the record's start: expected [{…"value":null,"state":"not_collected",…}]" and the card's "measuring since" words.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/132.sh. Black box on its own database with 095's made-up history: the first deploy record at -9 h, and three live landings after it with a median of 1.0 h. `spawn serve` answers /api/scorecard and /api/core-lines:
(1) not covered: the north star is {"value":3600000,"state":"no_range","measuring_since_ms":<-9 h>,"window":"since the deploy record began"}, the Scorecard's fleet value.
(3) then a deploy record 8 days back, and serve again: the north star is the Scorecard's fleet value with window "7d" and no measuring_since_ms.
(2) web/src/coreLines.ts over both answers: "Time from report to live (since the deploy record began)" and "1 h", then "Time from report to live (last 7 days)".
On main 15ee9707, 132.sh exits 1 with 3 checks failed:
- "(1) the north star while the record does not cover the 7 days: the Scorecard's value, since the record's start: expected [{"value":3600000,"state":"no_range","measuring_since_ms":…,"window":"since the deploy record began"}], got [{"value":null,"state":"not_collected",…}]";
- (3), covered: window null where "7d" is expected;
- (2), the card: its name lacks "(since the deploy record began)".
095.sh (with the kept edit), 081.sh, 084.sh and 086.sh pass on the candidate.

Verified by: the gate runs 132.sh and 095.sh on the candidate. After the landing, the lead reads the Core lines card's performance north star against the Scorecard page's fleet "Report to live" over 7 days: the same value, with "(since the deploy record began)" until 11-19 03:10 local and "(last 7 days)" after. The lead posts it in sync with the day-by-day figures above.
